485)༄༅/dpal ldan bla ma'i dkyil 'khor la cho ga nges don byin rlabs chu rgyun bzhugs so/

tei:div.tei:p: .*485) ༄༅/ dpal ldan bla ma'i dkyil 'khor la cho ga nges don byin rlabs chu rgyun bzhugs so/

486) na mo u rte bh+yaḥ gang zhig 'khor ba'i 'jigs dang zhi ba'i g.yang sa las// legs skyobs nges pa kho nar tshe gcig byang chen la// 'god mkhas bla ma mchog zhabs yang dag btud byas nas// de nyid mchog dang sgrub pa'i las rim 'dir 'god bya// mkha' mnyam pha ma drin can rnams// gtan bder 'god pa'i blo ldan gyi// skal bzang dad pa brtan po gang*// bla med sgrub cing mchod 'dod pas// yid mthun gnas khang byi dor byas// sku gzugs la sogs mchod 487) pa'i rten// bkram pa'i drung du stegs bzang sogs// me tog tshom bu lnga 'god cing*// bla ma'i gtor ma rgyan ldan dang*// bdud rtsis 1$0000180chag ngam chu la bdud rtsi ril bu btabs/ 1$1000180bkang ba'i thod pa bzhag /rnam lnga'i mchod pa rgya chen po// ser snas ma bcing bsod nams dang*// rang gzhan tshogs gnyis spel phyir 'god// mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍad rdor dril dang*// ḍa ma ru sogs rol mo'i tshogs// 'dzom bya gal te rnal 'byor pa// spros bral la ni mos blos rung*// 'jig rten bya brel kun spangs te// 488) bde ba'i stan 'khod skyabs yul la*// gus pas skyabs sems bdun dag bya// na mo dmigs med spros bral sangs rgyas chos kyi sku// 'gag med rang gsal dam chos longs spyod rdzogs// gnyis med thugs rje'i sprul sku dge 'dun bcas// dkon mchog sku gsum bla mar skyabs su mchi'o// 1$0000180lan gsum/ 1$10002501$0000250'gro kun bder bshegs snying po lhun grub kyang*// ma rig lhan skyes sgrib pas 'khor bar 1$10002501$1000180'khyams// rang rig smon 'jug don dam tshad med bzhi// yongs rdzogs byang chub sems mchog bskyed par bgyi'o// 1$0000180lan gsum/ 1$10002501$0000250rang sems bla mar rtogs pas gus phyag 'tshal// tshogs drug zhen pa bral ba'i mchod pa 'bul// gnyis 'dzin a 'thas sgrib tshogs mthol zhing bshags// thugs rje rgyun chad med la rjes yi rang*// khyab gdal ye shes chos bakhor bskor du gsol// mchog tu mi 'gyur chos skur bzhugs gsol 'debs// mkha' khyab 'gro

489) kun sku gsum thob phyir bsngo*// 'khor ba dong sprugs 'gro don 'grub par shog / ༈ skabs 'dir chog gzhung gzhan ltar gyi// bgegs bskrad dpung 'khor 'dir mi dgos// snang srid bla ma'i dkyil 'khor la// bsrung bya srung byed mtshan mas dben/ /de nas rang rgyud sbyong byed pa'i// yig brgya'i rnal 'byor sgom bzlas bya// ༈ chos kun sems kyi rol ba'i rang bzhin las// skad cig dran rdzogs bdag nyid rdo rje sems// dkar mdzes rdor dril phyag rgyas longs sku'i tshul// thugs kar hūm̐ la yig brgyas bskor bar gyur// om̐ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pa la ya/ badz+ra satwa te no pa ti ṣ+tha/ di dho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shrī yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga wān/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñtsa 490) badz+ri bha wa ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ 1$10001801$0000180long skabs dang bstun nas bzla/ 1$10002501$0000250 'khor ba thog mtha' med pa'i bag chags dang*// las nyon dam sdom nyams chags nyes ltung rigs// ma lus sngags dang ting 'dzin byin rlabs kyis// rmongs dag 'gro ba kun kyang de bzhin gyur// ༈ de nas lha yi rnal gyis// gnas khang yo byad mchod rdzas sogs// sngags dang ting 'dzin zung 'jug pas// byin gyis brlab pa 'di ltar bya// bdag nyid rdor sems thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig las// ye shes 'od 'phros snod bcud kun la phog /gnas yul gdos bcas ma yin chos dbyings zhing*// mchod rdzas yo byad kun bzang smon lam las// legs grub blo las 'das pa'i mchod sprin tshogs// zag med rgyun mi chad cing rab 'byams zhing*// ma lus yongs su khyab pa'i sgyu 'phrul che// phyi nang gsang ba de bzhin nyid rdzogs gyur/ om̐ āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra sarba pu dza me gha 491)

sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ swā hā/ ༈ de nas sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi// bla ma'i skyed chog 'di dag ni// rang sems stong pa'i gsal mdangs las// shugs 'byung rang shar nyid du bskyed// mdun gyi nam mkhar ye shes 'od lnga las// grub pa'i gzhal yas bkod pa bsam yas dbus// pad sdong 'dab bzhi ge sar nyi zla'i steng*// phyogs dus rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus pa'i// khyab bdag 'khor lo'i dbang phyug drin can rje// rtsa ba'i bla ma'i ngo bo 'dzam gling grags// dkar dmar mdangs ldan zhi dul dge slong tshul// sgom zhwa'i cod paṇa chos gos rnam gsum dang*// le rgan ber zlum pad+ma spungs 'dra gsol// skyil skrung mnyam gzhag ting 'dzin g.yo med kyis// snang srid zil gnon byin rlabs 'od 'bar bzhugs// steng gi nam mkhar pad zla 'ja' 'od klong*// rigs bdag rgyal ba kun yab 492) rdo rje 'chang*// 'gyur med mthing gsal thabs shes rdor dril bsnol// longs sku'i cha byad mtshan rdzogs rdor dril bzhugs// rtsa ba'i bla ma'i g.yas kyi pad 'dab steng*// he ru ka dpal te lo shes rab bzang*// sngo sang rus rgyan thor tshugs grub dbang chas// chos 'khor phyag rgya rdor skyil lta stangs bzhugs// g.yon gyi pad steng mkhas grub na ro pa// smug nag cang tel thod pa kha ṭaṃ bsnams// 'gyings bag g.yas brkyangs dpa' bo'i rol stangs can// stag sham rus rgyan thor lcog brjid ldan bzhugs// rgyab kyi pad+mar mnga' bdag lo tsā ba// che zhing snum brjid bag gro lhun chags sku// dbu skra lcang lo dar dkar phu dung dang*/ zab chen ber gsol phyag gnyis sa gnon mdzad// mdun gyi pad steng dbang phyug mi la rje// sngo dngas ras dkar na bza' sgom thag can// dbu skra sil 493) bu chos 'chad mnyam gzhag gis// gtso la zhal gzigs sems dpa'i skyil krung bzhugs// de dag rnams kyi phyi rol mtha' skor du// rgyud lung man ngag mdzod 'dzin bu rgyud tshogs// mdo sngags grub pa'i cha byad nges med du// gang 'dul sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs bzhugs// thams cad chos sku'i ngang las gzugs kyi sku// snang la rang bzhin ma grub 'od du 'bar//

zhing khams skus khyab sku nyid ye shes dbyings// zung 'jug mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'o// kun gyi spyi bor 'khor lo om̐ gyis mtshan// mgrin par pad+ma dmar po āḥyig dang*// thugs kar rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ mtshan pa'i// 'od kyis rgyal kun thugs rje rgyud bskul gyur// ༈ de ltar bzod nas chos sku la// dam tshig ye shes dbyer med kyang*// ting 'dzin nyams rtsal sbyong ba'i phyir// thugs rje'i mthu ldan bla ma rnams// ye shes spyan drangs byin rlabs myur// dad gdung mchi 494) ma g.yo nus pas// rol mo'i sgra dang spos kyi sprin// snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis spyan 'dren bya// om̐ āḥhūm̐/ chos dbyings gdod nas dag pa 'og min zhing*// lhun grub ye shes rang gsal pho brang nas// sku gsum yongs rdzogs bla ma spyan 'dren no// dad gus dam tshig gnas 'dir bshegs su gsol// zhing rnams skus khyab gshegs bzhugs mi dmigs kyang1$10002501$1000180*/ thugs rje'i sgyu'aphrul cir yang ston mdzad na// gdul bya'i yul dang mthun pa'i bkod yul gyis// zlos gar yang dag bsgyur bas gshegasasu gsol// chos sku gcig dang du ma'i spros bral yang*// gzugs sku ye shes rang gdangs 'gag med las// sprul sku gdul bya'i grangs mnyam de srid kyi// rnam 'dren bla ma'i tshogs rnams gshegs su gsol// khyab bdag rdor 'chang te lo nā ro dang*// mnga' bdag lo tsā rje btsun ras chen zhabs// 495) sku drin mnyam med mgon po 'dzam gling grags/ /rtsa rgyud bla ma'i tshogs bcas gshegs su gsol// snang grags bla ma'i ngo bor ro gcig kyang*// gang 'dul thugs rje'i rnam 'gyur sna tshogs pa'i// sangs rgyas sras bcas lha dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// ma lus mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// om̐ sarba ta thā ga ta/ ma hā gu ru rat+na sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa lā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho/

༈ spyan drangs tsam gyi nam mkha'i khams// kun khengs nyi zer rdul bzhin du// 'od zer 'khrig byon bla ma'i tshogs// dam tshig pa la thim par mos/ ༈ chos dbyings ye shes sgyu ma'i skur snang ba'i/ /bla ma mchog la gnyis 'dzin mi dmigs kyang*// bdag sogs 'gro ba'i gnyis 'dzin zhi slad du// sku dang ye shes dbyer med brtan par bzhugs// dzñā na kā yā dwā tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hūm̐/ de nas rang las sprul 496) pa'i lus// zhing gi rdul rnyed mkha' mnyam gyi// 'gro kun lhan cig bla ma la// sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal bya// gang sku mtshan dpe'i cha shas gdul bya'i mkhar// 'grib med rtag par gsal ba 'od snang gis// thar lam nges legs ston pa'i sgron me mchog /phan bde zla ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gsung dge ba gsum gyi bdud rtsi'i char// nyon mongs tsha gdung zhi mdzad ye shes rgyun/ byang chub myu gu bskyed mkhas thugs rje'i bcud// yid bzhin 'dod 'jo khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gzugs zab zhi spros bral rtog med las1$10002501$1000180// gus ldan yid la ji ltar bsam pa'i don// mchog thun dngos grub 'byung gnas zla med pa'i// rin chen gter mdzod khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// ༈ de nas phyi nang gsang ba dang*// de kho na nyidamachod pa kun// mchod yul mchod bya rang sems kyi// rol pa chen po'i 497) gar gyis 'bul// zhing khams rab 'byams bye ba khrag brgya kun// mchod yon bdud rtsi yan lag brgyad ldan gyis// yongs bkang bla ma mchog la 'bul lags kyi// 'gro kun bsam gtan rgya mtshor dbang 'byor shog /badz+ra aghaṃ pra ti'ats+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ 'dab stong ge sar rgyas pa'i pad+mo'i tshogs// dbang po'i gzhu ltar bkra ba'i mdangs can gyis// nam mkha' sa gzhi kun bkang 'bul lags na// 'gro kun brtson 'grus mchog la sbyor bar shog /badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/

spos kyi phye phul ri rab mnyam pa dang*// yid 'ong bsrung zhim bdug pa'i sprin tshogs bcas// dpag tshad bye bar khyab pa'i dri bzang mchod// phul bas 'gro kun tshul khrims rnam dag shog badz+ra dhu pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ gang gis mi sgribs rin chen snang ba'i 'od// nyin mtshan kun du 498) gsal dang ci mchog 'bru'i/ /sgron ma 'jig rten mtha' dag snang byed 'od// phul bas 'gro kun shes rab gsal bar shog /badz+ra a lo ke pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ 'khor ba'i tsha gdung kun sel dri layi chab// ma rig rmongs pa'i thib po zhi ba dang*// mngon mtho nges legs bde chen bskyed pa'i mchod// phul bas 'gro kun bzod pa'i go ldan shog badz+ra gan+dhe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ lha yi zhal zas ro brgya'i yon tan gyis// ting 'dzin sgo brgya 'byed nus zas mchog bshos// stong gsum yongs bkang bla ma rje la 'bul// 'gro kun sbyin pa'i dpal la longs spyod shog /badz+ra nai wi d+ya pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zin dang ma zin rnam par grags pa'i sgra /gti mug gnyid slong log lta'i sde tshogs skrag /chos sgras 'jig rten khyab byed rol mo'i tshogs// phul bas 'gro kun chos dbyings thob par shog badz+ra shap+ta 499) pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ phyi mchod nyer mchod phul ba'i rjes// nang ltar longs spyod lngas mchod de// 'jig rten gzugs kyi snang ba ji snyed pa// mdzes dang mi mdzes snang ba sems kyis 'phrul// gang snang ngo bo stong pa'i mchod 'bul bas// 'gro kun gti mug rnam snang skur grol shog badz+ra rū pa pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ ji ltar grags pa'i sgra ru gang bzung ba// snyan dang mi snyan 'dzin pas phyed pa tsam// thams cad grags stong rang grol mchod par 'bul// 'gro kun zhe sdang mi skyed skur shog /badz+ra shap+ta pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ tshor ba bzung dang ngan par bzung ba'i dri// gang yang rnam par rtog pas btags pas na// blo yis ma bslad tshor stong mchod pa yi// 'gro kun nga rgyal rin 'byung skur grol shog

/badz+ra ghan+dha pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ 500) thog mtha' bag chags mthu brtas zhim mngar ro/ gang la spong len 'khrul pa'i 'khor lo ni/ rgyun chad myong stong ro mnyam mchod 'bul bas// 'gro kun 'dod chags snang mtha'i skur grol shog /badz+ra ra sa pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ cir snang sgyu mar ma shes a 'thas kyis/ rang lagazugs reg bya bzang ngan dgag sgrub kun// chos nyid klong du la zlo'i mchod pa yis// 'gro kun phrag dog don grub skur grol shog /badz+ra spar+she pra tī ts+tsha swā hā// gsang ba bde stong lhan skyes kyi// mchod pa bla na med pas mchod// gang zhig 'khor ba'i gzhi rtsa chags sdang chas sdang gis// rgyu rkyen 'bras bus nyon mongs kun bskyed pa'i// mtshan nyid ji bzhin rig pa lhan skyes kyi// dga' ba bcu drug mchod pa kun gyi rab// thabs shes zung 'jug 'gyur bral bde ba'i mchog /zag med 501) ting 'dzin dbang bsgyur bla ma rnams// bde stong ye shes mchod pa'i dga' ston cher// rol nas sems can sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzod// gu h+ya dzña na ba ha dza ma hā pu dza hoḥ ༈ de nas mchod pa'i yang rab ni/ de kho na nyid don dam mchod// ༈ chos rnams kun gyi rang bzhin ma bcos pa// thog mtha' dbus med 'khor dang myang 'das zhes// mtshan mas ma bcings 'pho 'gyur bri dang bral// 'di ni mchod pa'i nang nas mchod chen po// mchod yul bla ma gdod ma'i chos kyi sku// mchod byed rang gsal rang rig rnal 'byor pa/ mchod bya'i dngos kun rang rtsal sgyu ma'i 'phrul// mtha' dag bzod nas yongs dag mchod pa'o// sarba dharmaḥ ma hā shun+ya ta pu dza ho/ ༈ de ltar kun rdzob don dam gyi// mchod pa'i rim pa grub 502) pa'i rjes// bla ma'il yon tan dran bya'i phyir// bstod dbyangs tshig don mthun par bya// ༈ e ma'o yon tan rgya mtsho'i bla ma la// bdag sogs tshur mthong skye bos bskal ba brgyar// bsngags kyang khyod kyi ba spu'i khungs gcig gi

/yon tan cha tsam rtogs par nus ma lags// e ma'o gdod nas rab dag spros pa'i tshogs// nyer zhi 'dus ma byas pa'i chos kyi sku /chos rnams kun gyi gnas lugs de bzhin nyid// gang de mgon po khyod kyi rang bzhin lags// e ma'o chos dbyings dag pa'i zhing khams nas// ngo mtshar mtshan rdzogs kha sbyor yan lag bdun// lhun grub nges pa lnga ldan zhing kun tu// yongs khyab longs sku'i dkyil 'khor khyod nyid lags// e ma'o nam mkha'i rab 'byams mtha' klas par// 'gro khams sna tshogs gang la gang 'dul ba'i// thugs bkod sprul bgrangs yas dus kun 503) tu// rgyun chad med de khyed kyi mtshan nyid lags// e ma'o rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed kyi// zhing khams ji snyed skra rtse'i khyon tsam du'ang*/ /khyed kyi thugs rje'i bkod pas ma khyab pa// nam yang srid min 'gog med rdzu 'phrul lags// e ma'o khyod kyi thugs rje'i nus stobs ni// se gol yun la'ang khams gsum sgrol nus pa'i// myur ba'i shugs dang bsgrun bral mthu stobs dpung*// bri gang med de khyod kyi phrin las lags// e ma ho shes bya'i chos tshul ji snyed kun// khyed thugs zab mo'i 'jings las byung ba'i phyir// cha shas tshig 'bru tsam gyis gdul bya'i rgyud//

bde slag grol ba khyod kyi 'gro don lags// e ma'o rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor phyogs bcu'i zhing*// kun khyab kun tu phan bde'i mdzad phrin dag /khyod kyi thugs rje'i 'od zer nyag gcig las// byung yang 'du 'god spros pas 504) dben pa lags// e ma ho dkon mchog ma lus khyod kho nar// 'dus na skyabs gnas su zhig ci phyir 'tshol// bdag sogs me snang 'khrul ba'i 'khor rgyun 'di// ma chod de srid khyed kyis skyabs mdzad gsol// ༈ om̐ āḥ hūm̐/ gling bzhi 'jig rten rab 'byams rgyud mtshams sbyor// rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i zhing gi 'byor pa'i tshogs// ma lus blo yis blangs te 'bul lags na// de snyed 'gro kun thugs rjes bzung du gsol// bdag lus longs spyod bdog pa ci mchis dang*// phung khams skye mched 'phral yun 'dun mar bcas// bdag tu bzung ba'i dngos por gyur tshad kun// 'bul gyi bdag 'dzin zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ /dngos dang dngos min mtha' las yongs grol zhing*// skye 'gag gnas dang 'gro 'ong rtag chad kyi// 504) ming mtshan las 'das gnas lugs maṇ+ḍal mchod// phul nas bla ma mchog dang dbyer med shog /gu ru rat+na maṇ+ḍal pu dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ ༈ de nas bla ma'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ rang sems gshis gdangs rtsal gsum po/ ye nas dbyer med shes pa'i ngang*// 'dzab bsnyan 'di ni ci 'grub bzla// om̐ āḥhūm̐ gu ru rat+na sarba sid+dhi hūm̐/ rig pa ma labacos ma yengs pas// bzlas dang brgya stong khri 'bum bzla/ /bla ma rnams kyi gnas su 'bru// gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing*// 'byung ste rang gi gnas gsum thim// sgo gsum las nyon sgrib tshogs dag /sku gsung thugs dbang byin rlabs dang*// dngos grub yongs rdzogs thob par dmigs// bsnyen sgrub bye ba sa ya las// bla ma'i gsol 'debs lan gcig gi

nus pa 'bum phrag char mi phod// 506) lam zab bla ma'i dbang thob na// myur ba nyid du mngon sangs rgya/ /zhes sogs rgyud lung brjod mi lang*// phan yon nyams len brtson la reg /thun mtshams gtor ma bdud rtsi yi// mchod pa 'dis kyang tshogs chen 'phel// bdag nyid lhar gsal thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig las// om̐ āḥhūm̐ 'phros bdud rtsi'i gtor ma bcas// ma dag bags rtsogs skyon sbyang ye shes kyi// bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'dod yon phun tshogs gyur// om̐ āḥhūm̐/ rang bzhin gsal mdangs thabs mchog gtor ma dang*// ngo bo stong nyid shes rab bdud rtsi che// gnyis med ting 'dzin mthu yis byin rlabs nas// rje btsun bla ma'i tshogs la mchod par 'bul// yi dam lha dang mkha' 'gro chos srung rigs// mchod 'os kun la mchod pa'i sprin sprin phul bas// byang chub sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen zhi ba dang*// mchog dang thun mong dgos grub stsal du gsol// om̐ gu ru 507) de wa ḍā ki nī dharma pā la sa pā ri wā ra i daṃ ba ling+ta*/ a mri ta pu dza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ༈ de nas skabs 'dir 'dod don gyi// gsol gdab thugs rje'i phrin las la/ bskul ba'i tshig 'di dad gus dang*/ gdung ba'i shugs bskyed nan tan bya'o// phyogs dus rgyal ba thugs rje'i mnga' bdag kun// yongs zlum bdag sogs snyigs dus gdul bya'i tshogs// 'dul mdzad rje btsun bla ma tshar dngar rnams// mkhyen brtse ye shes gzigs pa sgrib med la// bdag sogs rmongs pas snyan bskul mi 'tshal yang*// lnga brgya tha ma'i dus kyi ngang tshul dang*// rin chen bstan pa gzugs brnyan la spyod pa'i// rnam 'gyur mi bzad ngan pa'i snang tshul 'di// mkhyen pa'i spyan ldan rnams kyis gzigs bzhin du// thugs rje'i nus stobs btang snyoms mi 'jog cing*/ rmu rgod gdul bya yal bar 508) ma dor bar// gdul dka' 'dul ba'i phrin las dus la babs// snod bcud 'byung 'khrug 'pho 'gyur rba klong gis// skye 'gro bzod dka'i sdug bsngal du mas gzir// nad mug 'khrug rtsod 'byung po'i 'tshe ba sogs// ma lus myur du zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/

bstan la zhugs rnams chags sdang chags sdang kun slong gis// rgyud dkrug sdom gsum ring dor bgamed kyi/ /spyod pas dus 'da' thos bsam sgom mi brtson// mtha' dag chos bzhin spyod par byin gyis rlobs// rgyu 'bras dam sdom rim gnyis rgyang bsring zhing*// kha na ma tho'i zas dang spyod pas g.yengs// dug gsum me 'bar rang gzhan rgyud bsreg pa'i// chos gzugs chos la bsgyur bar byin gyis rlobs// sgrub rgyud rnal 'byor spyod pa'i gdams ngag rnams// zag bcas lam dang stong ltas mi bslu bar// bde stong zung 'jug 509) ye shes phyag rgya che// ma nor mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs// yon tan ltar snang lam rtags phra mo la/ /zhen 'dod ngar 'dzin khong sran mi zhugs par// sa lam rnal 'byor bzhi 'bras mthar phyin te// sku bzhi dbyer med 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// tshe 'di'i 'dod don dngos grub phra mo dang*// chos brgyad khong du bcangs pa'i 'gro don sogs// don gnyis 'dra min bdud kyis mi bslu bar// mchog dngos yang dag 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// ༈ de nas mjug gi las rim rnams// bya ba'am bdal te dus bzang gi /tshogs mchod bya bar spro 'dzom na// sdig pas bsgrub pa ma yin pa'i// tshogs kyi longs spyod gang 'byor bshams// thod pa'i bdud rtsi 'thor byas la// bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs 'di bzhin bya'o/ om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa// bdag nyid thugs ka'i 510) hūm̐ las ram̐ yam̐ kham̐// 'phros pa las byung ye shes me rlung chus/ tshogs kyi 'bag rtsogs dri ma bsregs gtor bkrus// om̐ āḥhūm̐ 'phros sbyang rtogs sbar ba yis// tshogs rdzas ngo bo ye shes bdud rtsi la// rnam pa gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos// zag med 'dod pa'i yon tan bsam yas kyis// skyabs mchog bla ma'i tshigs rnams mnyes byed gyur// o āḥhūm̐/

de nas tshogs mchod mgron gyur rnams// spyan drangs phyir du dad gus kyis// spos bsreg cang tel dril bu dang*// dbyangs snyan mgrin gcig 'di skad zer// hūm̐/ gnas rang bzhin lhun grub chos kyi dbyings// yul dngos 'dzin bral ba'i zhing khams nas// don chos sku spros dang bral ba'i gdangs// rje ye shes sgyu 'phrul bla ma rnams// gnas dam tshig gtsang ma'i tshogs khang 'dir// dus khyad par can gyi dge mtshan la// bu mos gus gdung bas spyan 'dren na// tshogs 511) 'khor lo'i 'du bar gshegs su gsol// sku gsal stong 'ja' 'od laṃ se laṃ// gsung rdo rje'i mgur dbyangs kyu ru ru// thugs bde stong ting 'dzin cham se cham// 'di byin rlabs 'beb cing gshegs su gsol// gnas gdams ngag mchod rdzas 'dzom pa yin// dus tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dga' ston la// rje bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gror bcas// tshogs mchod pa'i mgron du gshegs su gsol// gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni sa ma ya a we sha ya hring hring dzaḥ ༈ de nas tshogs kyi zhal zas kun// tshan pa gsum du spros bcas te// phud rnams rin chen snod du spungs// lhag ma'i mgron la 'bul phyir bshams// thod pa'ilabadud rtsi khyab par bran// ༈ rje btsun bla ma mchog dang 512) sprul ba'i lha// yi dam mkha' 'gro chos srung bcas rnams la// 'dod yon rmad byung tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul// zag med dgyes pa chen por rol bar mdzod// rtsa rgyud bla ma'i thugs dam skongs nas kyang*// tshe gcig sangs rgyas dngos grub rtsal du gsol// yi dam lha tshogs thugs rje skongs nas kyang*// mchog thun dngos grub la lus stsal du gsol// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bsakongs nas kyang*// rnam bzhi'i phrin las thogs med sgrub mdzad gsol// chos skyong srung ma'i thugs dam skongs nas kyang*// bstan la gnod pa'i dgra gegs sgrol mdzad gsol// ga ṇa tsakra pu dza khā hi/

༈ bar 'dir sgrub pa po rnams la// dngos grub tshogs kyi longs spyod bkye// phung khams lha yi dkyil 'khor la// mchod pa'i 'du shes ldan par rol// tshogs kyi dam las mi 'da' zhing*// bag med tha mal spyod pa spangs// rdo rje glu sogs bya ba yang*/ /rdo rje sku ni mi phyed pa'am// 513) nges pa'i don la 'jug pa'i phyir// grub thob rnams kyi rdo rje'i mgur// te lo zhabs kyi gaṅga ma// nā ro'i lta ba mdor bsdus dang*// chos drug dril ba'i mgur drug dang*// mar pa'i stong nyid snying rje ma// nang gi yan lag bdun pa sogs// mi la'i thim pa nyer brgyad dang*// ston pa dbus bzhud la sogs dang*// sgam po'i bde chen chos nyid ma// gsol 'debs gangs dkar ma la sogs/ gzhan yang rdo ha brgyad skor dang*// dam pa'i grub thob lnga bcu'i glu /la sogs nges don rtogs mgur rigs// dbyangs dang bcas pa'am me na yang*// gsal dag snyan pas bsgrags pa na// byin rlabs phebs dang mkha' 'gro dgyes// rnal 'byor nyams rtogs 'phel bar bshad// de ma yin pa 'jig rten pa'i// glu gar ku co rtsod pa dang*// chos min bag med spyod pa'i rigs// byas na tshogs kyi 514) dam nyams shing*/ bka' srung mkha' 'gro khros pa yi// bka' chad 'phral du 'byung bar gsungs/ /de na tshul bzhin spyod pa gces// ༈ tshogs la rol ba'i rjes thog der// tshogs lhag gral gyi mtha' logs su// man dzi'i khar bzhag bdud rtsis bran// 'bru gsum lan gsum brjod pa dang*/ om̐ a kā ro mu khaṃ/ sarba dharmā naṃ/ ād+ya nut+pan+na twata/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ hūm̐/ sngon tshe rgyal ba rig 'dzin grub mchog gi /spyan sngar khas blangs dam tshig gnyer bzhengs pa'i// gnas yul dur khrod rgyu ba'i ḍā ki ma// ye shes las dang 'jig rten sna tshogs kyi// mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro bran dang yang g.yog bcas// gzhan yang 'jig rten khams skyong mthu bo che// bstan pa bsrung

515) zhing rnal 'byor skyong ba'i tshogs/ ma lus rdo rje'i phaṃ lam tshogs kyi lhag /dam tshig bdud rtsi 'dod yon phun tshogs 'di// bzhes nas sangs rgyas bstan pa dri med skyong*// chos bzhin spyod pa'i gdams ngag mthun rkyen sgrubs// rgyal khams bde zhing sbyin bdag bar chad zhi// bstan la gnod pa'i bdud sde thal bar lhogs// rnal 'byor bdag gi ji ltar bcol ba yi// phrin las ma g.yel myur du grub mdzad la// sgrub rgyud bstan pa bsrung zhing skyong mdzad cig /badz+ra a ra li ḍa ki ni sarba sa ma ya/ u tsit+ta ba ling ta khā hi/ zhes brjod lhag la bshal chur bcas/ gtsang zhing mtho ba'i phyogs su 'bul// ༈ de nas mjug gi cho ga las/ dang por dngos grub blang ba ni/ byin rlabs 'byung gnas rtsa rgyud bla ma'i tshogs// ye shes thugs rje rgyun chad ma mchis kyang*// deng 'dir mchod cing 516) bsgrub pa'i don 'bras su// sgrub mchog bdag la dngos grub char chen phob/ /'chi med tshe dang chos mthun longs spyod dang*// ting 'dzin nyams rtogs gong 'phel sa lam 'grod// mchog gi dngos grub myur du stsal du gsol// ka ya wak+tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi pha la ho/ ༈ bla ma'i gtor ma bdud rtsi bcas/ /dngos grub rdzas su blang bar bya'o// de nas cho ga'i nyes byas bshags// bdag cag ma rig 'khrul ba'i bag chags mthus// bla ma mchod pa'i las la 'gal 'khrul dang*// sgo gsum nyes dang yo byad ma dag sogs// ci mchis chos dbyings klong du bzod par gsol// oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya = de nas dge ba'i rtsa ba ni// 'gro la bsngo shing smon lam gdab// bdag gis dge ba kun las mchog rab phul// dpal ldan bla ma'i gsang gsum dkyil 'khor che// bsgrub cing mchod pa'i dge 'bras 517) bla na med// 'di dang 'khor 'das lam gsum rnam dkar kun// gcig bsdom chos min bsam pas ma bslad par// mkha' khyab 'gro kun rdzogs byang thob phyir bsngo*// lhag bsam mthu dang bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis// nam mkhas gar khyab drin can pha ma'i tshogs// las nyon 'khrul 'khor sdug bsngal shugs drag gi

/rgyu rkyen 'bras bur bcas pa rgyun chod nas// sku bzhi ye shes rdo rje bla ma yi// go 'phang myur thob srid zhi gtan sgrol shog / ༈ de nas rten 'brel me tog gi /char babs bkra shis glu dbyangs bya// ༈ chos dbyings mi 'gyur rdo rje dkyil 'khor gyi// khyab bdag rigs mchog rdo rje 'chang dbang gi /thugs rje ye shes rdo rje kun khyab pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /thog med mkhyen pa'i shes rab phul byung gis// chos kun gnas lugs shes rab zag mos 518) gzigs// grub dbang te lo shes rab bzang po yi// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /nges gsang mchog zhugs ye shes mkha' 'gro yis// lung bstan bla mas ye shes mngon gyur mdzad// mkhas grub nā ro ye shes dngos grub kyi// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /theg mchog gsang sngags chos kyi dbang mdzod 'dzin// rgyud lung man ngag chos kyi 'khor lo bsgyur// sgra bsgyur mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyi// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog / sgrub rgyud pad tshal bzhad pa'i gangs can ljongs// ting 'dzin ge sar bzhad pa'i rtser son pa// dbang phyug mi la bzhad pa rdo rje yi// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /zas gtsang sras po 'dzam gling sgron mchog gi /nges don bstan pas 'dzam gling khyab mdzad pa'i// phrin las mnyam med 'dzam gling grags pa yi// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /bshad sgrub rgyud pa'i bla ma thugs rje'i gter// drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma yid bzhin nor// dbyer med rang rig 519) bla ma mngon gyur pa'i// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog / ༈ de nas bla ma'i dkyil 'khor rnams thams cad gtso bo nyid la thim/ de nyid skar mda' rgyugs pa bzhin// tshur byon bdag gi spyi bor thim// de rjes rang nyid rdor sems kyang*// mtha' nas rim 'dus hūm̐ la bsdu// hūm̐ yang gyen rdzogs thig le dang*// de yang mkha' la sprin yal ltar// gyur pa'i ngang nas dus gsum gyi// rtog tshogs sprin bral mkha' bzhin bzhag

/bla ma chos sku'i rang zhal mjal// slar yang rjes thob rig gdangs las// sgo gsum lha dang bla ma ni// dbyer med rang rig yengs med bskyangs// a 'thas 'khrul phyir mi'abrang zhing*// chos brgyad zhen 'khris rbad kyi bcad// tshe 'di'i bya ba lings kyi btang*// skyid sdug gang byung thugs rjer bsam// mos 520) gus rgyun chad med pa ni// bla ma sgrub pa'i dam tshig go /de ltar rgyal ba'i bka' gsang rgya cha'i yang bcud// gsang sngags rtsa ba rdo rje slob dpon nyid sgrub pa'i// las rim 'di ni dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho ma lus pa'i// mchog dang phul yang rab bskal bzang spyod yul lo/ kye ma ding sang chos kun ri mo'i mar me ltar// snang yang don byed nus pa'i dben te gzug sabarnyan tsam// khyad par sngags kyi smin grol phyag len bro pa yi// glu gar bzhin du zang zing mang byed don gyis stongs// de phyir tshig nyung don gtsor ston pa gyis shig ces// 'gro ba'i mgon po zla 'od gzhon nu slar yang deng*// snyigs dus sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i dpal du mngon byon pa'i// mchog gi sprul sku thub bstan larin chen bzang po'i dpal// gang gi bka' mchid dzam+bu'i gser gyi lacod pan nyid// gtsig tu bcings 521) nas sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i zhabs rtogs su// smon pa bzang ldan sna tshogs rang grol ku sā lis// pak+shu'i klung 'gram kun tu snang ba'i ri bor spor// bkod pa'i dge ba byang sems cha shas yongs rdzogs kyi// mthu nus mngon par gsal nges don sgrub rgyud bstan// rab rgyas yun gnas de 'dzin skyes bu ting 'dzin 'phel// skye dgus gtsug bsten kun kyang rdo rje 'chang 'grub shog /mastu sarba dza ga taṃ/ dwi shu d+dha kṛtra shubhaṃ/
